spans.s:
The augment क् (कुक्) is added to the words वाकिन etc. when the Patronymic affix फिन् follows.

Terms: फिन्

The long is optionally substituted for the इ in क्षि before the Past Participle in क्त when it is not in the sense of the future Passive Participle in ण्यत् when the word means 'imprecation' or 'a miserable plight'.

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes

A Vocative, at the beginning of a sentence, is repeated, when envy, praise, anger, blame, or threat is meant by the speaker.

Terms: Doubling of Words

Up to the close of this chapter (पाद), is always to be supplied the words 'the last vowel of a sentence is प्लुत and has the acute'.

Terms: प्लुत
